# Sara Foundation Africa

> Non-profit headquartered in London, United Kingdom, equipping African youth and women with tech skills, mentorship and job placement across 35 universities in 11 African countries.

Sara Foundation runs three flagship programmes — CAP (Community Access & Participation Pathway), FLIP (Female Learning & Inclusion Pathway) and EJP (Educational Journey Pathway) — combining intensive learning, mentorship and real-world projects to prepare African students and graduates for tech careers.

## Verified impact figures

- 35 partner universities
- 763 CAP participants trained
- 52 women trained through FLIP
- 11 African countries reached
- 705 people referred for job placement (includes 696 referred via EJP)
- Sponsorship cost: £500 sponsors one student; £50 sponsors one module; £10 recurring monthly gifts are welcome

## Programs

- [CAP Tech Hub](/programs/cap): Community Access & Participation Pathway — a 6-week intensive covering software engineering, cybersecurity, data analysis, product marketing and the founders track. Cohort 3 applications are open.
- [CAP Apply](/programs/cap/apply): Application form for the CAP cohort, including partner reference codes.
- [FLIP](/programs/flip): Female Learning & Inclusion Pathway — mentorship, fellowships and workshops for women in tech across Africa.
- [FLIP Apply](/programs/flip/apply): Application form for the FLIP fellowship.
- [EJP](/programs/gjp): Educational Journey Pathway — talent identification and employer matching, delivered in partnership with the Nigerian Jubilee Fellows Programme (NJFP).
- [EJP Apply](/programs/gjp/apply): Application form for EJP talent placement.
